description: Animated mascot overlay for web pages: a gothic poltergeist drawn on a canvas that walks on the page's headings, text and buttons. Zero dependencies, vanilla JS core plus an SSR-safe React adapter (Next.js App Router ready).
rules: Install with `npm install @d4ndel1on/pagegeist`. React apps import `<Pagegeist />` from `@d4ndel1on/pagegeist/react`; everything else uses `createPagegeist()` from `@d4ndel1on/pagegeist`.
Mount exactly one mascot, once, high in the tree (root layout) – never per page or route.
Call createPagegeist() only in the browser (useEffect, mount hook or module script); importing is SSR-safe. Pair every createPagegeist() with destroy() on teardown.
In the Next.js App Router, render <Pagegeist /> directly in a server component layout – no dynamic(..., { ssr: false }). Callback props need a client component wrapper.
React props are declarative (removing a prop restores its default); instance.update() merges. container, size and random cannot be changed via update().
Pass pauseControl (or wire your own control to `paused`) for WCAG 2.2.2, and keep the default reducedMotion: 'static'.
